invariants.rationale: The method calls map.getLayers() unconditionally, so map must be non-null.
spriteCache methods (clear, begin, end, draw) are called, which requires spriteCache to be non-null.
viewBounds fields are accessed (x, y, width, height), so viewBounds must be non-null.
cacheBounds fields (x, y, width, height) are written/read, so cacheBounds must be non-null.
The method assigns map.getLayers() and iterates/calls getCount()/get(index), so getLayers() must be non-null.
